title: Malformed frozen Spend Category ancestry returns the stable integrity failure
steps: Supply Budget Actual members with, in turn, an empty ancestry for a categorized member, an ancestry whose final element differs from the assigned Spend Category identifier, an ancestry repeating one identifier, an ancestry naming a Spend Category absent from the known evidence set, and a non-empty ancestry for an uncategorized member. Calculate the Budget Position for each.
expected: Each case returns the stable BUDGET integrity failure with no partial totals, no position row, and an amount-free integrity reason token.
